matviews.name: analytics_base
matviews.definition:
SELECT lr.listing_key,
    lr.standard_status,
    lr.list_price,
    lr.close_price,
    lr.days_on_market,
    lr.price_per_sqft,
    lr.property_type,
    lr.property_sub_type,
    lr.postal_code,
    lr.county_or_parish AS county,
    lr.listing_contract_date,
    lr.close_date,
    ((lr.original_list_price IS NOT NULL) AND (lr.list_price < lr.original_list_price)) AS has_price_reduction,
    lr.price_change_timestamp,
    lr.listing_terms,
    (date_trunc('month'::text, (lr.listing_contract_date)::timestamp with time zone))::date AS contract_month,
    (date_trunc('month'::text, (lr.close_date)::timestamp with time zone))::date AS close_month,
    lg.region_slug,
    lg.community_slug,
        CASE
            WHEN ((lr.property_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Residential'::character varying, 'Residential Lease'::character varying])::text[])) THEN 'residential'::text
            WHEN ((lr.property_type)::text = 'Land'::text) THEN 'land'::text
            WHEN ((lr.property_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Multiple Dwellings'::character varying, 'Comm/Industry Sale'::character varying, 'Comm/Industry Lease'::character varying, 'Business Opportunity'::character varying, 'Rental'::character varying, 'Farm/Ranch'::character varying])::text[])) THEN 'commercial'::text
            WHEN (lr.property_type IS NULL) THEN 'residential'::text
            ELSE 'other'::text
        END AS property_segment
   FROM (listing_records lr
     LEFT JOIN listing_geography lg ON (((lg.listing_key)::text = (lr.listing_key)::text)))
  WHERE (((lr.county_or_parish)::text = 'Maricopa'::text) AND (lr.list_price >= (200000)::numeric) AND (lr.listing_contract_date >= '2021-01-01'::date) AND ((lr.close_date IS NULL) OR (lr.close_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + '30 days'::interval))));

matviews.name: mv_absorption
matviews.definition:
WITH absorption_calc AS (
         SELECT mv_supply_demand.scope_type,
            mv_supply_demand.scope_key,
            mv_supply_demand.property_segment,
            mv_supply_demand.month,
            mv_supply_demand.closed_sales AS monthly_closings,
            avg(mv_supply_demand.closed_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mv_supply_demand.scope_type, mv_supply_demand.scope_key, mv_supply_demand.property_segment ORDER BY mv_supply_demand.month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_monthly_closings_3mo,
            (sum(mv_supply_demand.new_listings) OVER (PARTITION BY mv_supply_demand.scope_type, mv_supply_demand.scope_key, mv_supply_demand.property_segment ORDER BY mv_supply_demand.month) - sum(mv_supply_demand.closed_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mv_supply_demand.scope_type, mv_supply_demand.scope_key, mv_supply_demand.property_segment ORDER BY mv_supply_demand.month)) AS cumulative_inventory
           FROM mv_supply_demand
        )
 SELECT scope_type,
    scope_key,
    property_segment,
    month,
    GREATEST(cumulative_inventory, (0)::numeric) AS active_count,
    monthly_closings,
        CASE
            WHEN (avg_monthly_closings_3mo > (0)::numeric) THEN round((GREATEST(cumulative_inventory, (0)::numeric) / avg_monthly_closings_3mo), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS months_of_supply
   FROM absorption_calc;

matviews.name: mv_active_listings
matviews.definition:
SELECT lr.listing_key,
    lr.listing_id,
    lr.standard_status,
    lr.mls_status,
    lr.latitude,
    lr.longitude,
        CASE
            WHEN ((lr.latitude IS NOT NULL) AND (lr.longitude IS NOT NULL)) THEN st_setsrid(st_makepoint((lr.longitude)::double precision, (lr.latitude)::double precision), 4326)
            ELSE NULL::geometry
        END AS geometry,
    lr.city,
    lr.postal_code,
    lr.county_or_parish AS county,
    lr.unparsed_address,
    lr.street_number,
    lr.street_name,
    lr.street_suffix,
    lr.street_dir_prefix,
    lr.unit_number,
    lr.subdivision_name AS subdivision_display,
    lr.list_price,
    lr.close_price,
        CASE
            WHEN ((lr.living_area > (0)::numeric) AND (lr.list_price > (0)::numeric)) THEN round((lr.list_price / lr.living_area), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS price_per_sqft,
    lr.listing_contract_date,
    lr.close_date,
    lr.modification_timestamp,
    lr.status_change_timestamp,

    ((lr.photo_urls -> 0) ->> 'url'::text) AS primary_photo_url,
    lr.virtual_tour_url,
    lr.parcel_number,
    to_tsvector('english'::regconfig, ((((((COALESCE(lr.unparsed_address, ''::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(lr.city, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(lr.subdivision_name, ''::character varying))::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(lr.public_remarks, ''::text))) AS search_vector,

   FROM (listing_records lr
     LEFT JOIN listing_geography lg ON (((lr.listing_key)::text = (lg.listing_key)::text)))
  WHERE (((lr.standard_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Active'::character varying, 'Active Under Contract'::character varying, 'Coming Soon'::character varying, 'Pending'::character varying])::text[])) AND (lr.is_deleted = false) AND (lr.internet_entire_listing_display_yn = true));

matviews.name: mv_community_scorecard
matviews.definition:
SELECT 'metro'::text AS scope_type,
    'phoenix_metro'::text AS scope_key,
    'all'::text AS property_segment,
    percentile_cont((0.5)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((analytics_base.close_price)::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE (((analytics_base.standard_status)::text = 'Closed'::text) AND (analytics_base.close_month >= ((CURRENT_DATE - '1 year'::interval))::date))) AS median_price,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (((analytics_base.standard_status)::text = 'Closed'::text) AND (analytics_base.close_month >= ((CURRENT_DATE - '1 year'::interval))::date))) AS total_closed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((analytics_base.standard_status)::text = 'Active'::text)) AS total_active,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((analytics_base.standard_status)::text = 'Pending'::text)) AS total_pending,
    avg(analytics_base.days_on_market) FILTER (WHERE (((analytics_base.standard_status)::text = 'Closed'::text) AND (analytics_base.close_month >= ((CURRENT_DATE - '1 year'::interval))::date))) AS avg_dom,

    c.relname AS f_table_name,
    a.attname AS f_geography_column,
    postgis_typmod_dims(a.atttypmod) AS coord_dimension,
    postgis_typmod_srid(a.atttypmod) AS srid,
    postgis_typmod_type(a.atttypmod) AS type
   FROM pg_class c,
    pg_attribute a,
    pg_type t,
    pg_namespace n
  WHERE ((t.typname = 'geography'::name) AND (a.attisdropped = false) AND (a.atttypid = t.oid) AND (a.attrelid = c.oid) AND (c.relnamespace = n.oid) AND (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND (NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace)) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text));

SELECT (current_database())::character varying(256) AS f_table_catalog,
    n.nspname AS f_table_schema,
    c.relname AS f_table_name,
    a.attname AS f_geometry_column,
    COALESCE(postgis_typmod_dims(a.atttypmod), sn.ndims, 2) AS coord_dimension,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(postgis_typmod_srid(a.atttypmod), 0), sr.srid, 0) AS srid,
    (replace(replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(postgis_typmod_type(a.atttypmod)), 'GEOMETRY'::text), st.type, 'GEOMETRY'::text), 'ZM'::text, ''::text), 'Z'::text, ''::text))::character varying(30) AS type
   FROM ((((((pg_class c
     JOIN pg_attribute a ON (((a.attrelid = c.oid) AND (NOT a.attisdropped))))
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON ((c.relnamespace = n.oid)))
     JOIN pg_type t ON ((a.atttypid = t.oid)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            replace(split_part(s.consrc, ''''::text, 2), ')'::text, ''::text) AS type
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE (s.consrc ~~* '%geometrytype(% = %'::text)) st ON (((st.connamespace = n.oid) AND (st.conrelid = c.oid) AND (a.attnum = ANY (st.conkey)))))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            (replace(split_part(s.consrc, ' = '::text, 2), ')'::text, ''::text))::integer AS ndims
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE (s.consrc ~~* '%ndims(% = %'::text)) sn ON (((sn.connamespace = n.oid) AND (sn.conrelid = c.oid) AND (a.attnum = ANY (sn.conkey)))))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            (replace(replace(split_part(s.consrc, ' = '::text, 2), ')'::text, ''::text), '('::text, ''::text))::integer AS srid
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE (s.consrc ~~* '%srid(% = %'::text)) sr ON (((sr.connamespace = n.oid) AND (sr.conrelid = c.oid) AND (a.attnum = ANY (sr.conkey)))))
  WHERE ((c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND (NOT (c.relname = 'raster_columns'::name)) AND (t.typname = 'geometry'::name) AND (NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace)) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text));
